BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has purchased 416,209 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities at a volume-weighted average price of 903.3400 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 909.2000 pence and the lowest at 896.8000 pence. These shares were acquired from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc as part of a share buyback program announced on March 2, 2026, and are scheduled for cancellation. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 27 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
